scenario: Turn lab notes, portal messages, and Fitbit data into a pre-visit symptom triage report.

why: C31 takes points away for 'fabricating' Fitbit sleep-stage values, but the Fitbit records actually contain the per-night deep and REM minutes, so a report that surfaces those real values is wrongly marked as fabricating. C26 rewards leaving the sleep data at a high level with no stage table, but the prompt only asks to include the Fitbit data and never rules out a table, so a correct report that lays the real values out in a table loses points.
fix: Drop C31 since the sleep-stage values are present in the records, and loosen C26 so presenting the real values in a table isn't penalized.
agree: Yes — both agree it holds up.
